grammar_title: 主谓一致(1):集合名词 · and 连接的主语 · each/every/either/neither 与 a number of / the number of
source: 外研社版选择性必修第三册 Unit 3 Using language:Subject-verb agreement (1)。句子围绕 D-Day/二战/和平主题,靠语境(its/it/as one body 表整体;their/themselves/among themselves 表成员;就近原则)确保答案唯一。

points.point: 集合名词作主语(看作整体用单数 / 强调成员用复数)
points.overview: army/enemy/team/crew/government/crowd/committee/jury/staff/nation 等集合名词:看作一个整体(常带 it / as one body / whole)时谓语用单数;强调内部成员各自动作(常带 their / themselves / among themselves / 复数代词)时用复数。police/people 等通常作复数。

points.point: and 连接的主语(两者用复数 / 同一整体用单数)
points.overview: and 连接两个不同的人或物 → 复数(常各带冠词或 both…and…);指同一个人/同一事物或固定搭配(bread and butter、war and peace、the general and commander 同指一人、aim and purpose 同一概念) → 单数。

points.point: each/every/either/neither 与 a number of / the number of(含就近原则)
points.overview: each/every/either/neither + 单数;every…and every… 与 many a + 单数。a number of + 复数,the number of + 单数。neither…nor…/either…or… 遵循就近原则(谓语与最近的主语一致)。

questions.stem: The whole army ____ ready to move the moment the order came.
questions.explanation: army 由 whole 强调为一个整体,看作单数,过去时用 was。

questions.stem: The enemy ____ hiding in their hundreds along the top of the cliffs.
questions.explanation: their hundreds 说明把 enemy 看作分散行动的成员,用复数 were。

questions.stem: Acting as one body, the government ____ decided to keep the date a secret.
questions.explanation: as one body 把 government 视为整体,用单数 has decided。

questions.stem: The small rescue team ____ led by a single captain who had survived Omaha Beach.
questions.explanation: 由一名队长统领,team 作整体看,过去被动用 was led。

questions.stem: Working as one, the crew ____ able to reach the beach safely.
questions.explanation: as one 强调 crew 为一个整体,用单数 was。

questions.stem: The crew ____ divided among themselves about which route to take.
questions.explanation: among themselves 表明成员各持己见,用复数 were。

questions.stem: The planning committee ____ made up of officers from three countries.
questions.explanation: be made up of 把 committee 当作一个整体,用单数 was made up of。

questions.stem: The committee ____ still arguing among themselves at midnight.
questions.explanation: among themselves 强调成员之间各自争论,用复数 were。

questions.stem: The frightened crowd on the sand ____ unable to move, like one terrified mass.
questions.explanation: one terrified mass 把 crowd 看作整体,用单数 was。

questions.stem: The crowd ____ waving their flags and cheering the soldiers home.
questions.explanation: their flags 表明强调人群中的成员,用复数 were。

questions.stem: The ship's company ____ proud of what it had achieved that day.
questions.explanation: 后文用 it 指代,说明把 company 看作整体,用单数 was。

questions.stem: The team of nurses ____ doing their best to save every wounded man.
questions.explanation: their best 表明强调护士们各自的努力,用复数 were。

questions.stem: Your enemy ____ a single, well-trained force that fights as one.
questions.explanation: a single force / fights as one 把 enemy 看作一个整体,现在时用单数 is。

questions.stem: The jury at the war trial ____ unable to agree among themselves.
questions.explanation: among themselves 强调陪审团成员意见不一,用复数 were。

questions.stem: The jury ____ going to give its verdict tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: its verdict 用 it 指代,把 jury 看作整体,用单数 is。

questions.stem: The staff at the field hospital ____ doing their jobs without any rest.
questions.explanation: their jobs 强调工作人员各自忙碌,用复数 were。

questions.stem: The whole nation ____ grateful to the soldiers who had set it free.
questions.explanation: whole nation 及后文 it 把国家看作整体,用单数 was。

questions.stem: The police ____ still searching the ruined streets for hidden weapons.
questions.explanation: police 通常作复数对待,用复数 were。

questions.stem: The group of survivors ____ growing smaller as one by one its members pass away.
questions.explanation: its members 用 it 指代,把 group 看作整体,用单数 is。

questions.stem: Moving as one, the band ____ marching slowly past the war memorial.
questions.explanation: as one 强调乐队整体行进,用单数 is。

questions.stem: Britain and Canada ____ among the Allied nations that joined the landings.
questions.explanation: Britain and Canada 是两个国家,主语为复数,用 were。

questions.stem: Bread and butter ____ often all the soldiers had to eat at dawn.
questions.explanation: bread and butter 是一道食品的固定搭配,指同一事物,用单数 was。

questions.stem: The general and commander of the whole operation ____ the same man, Eisenhower.
questions.explanation: the general and commander 只用一个冠词、同指一人,用单数 was。

questions.stem: The general and the sergeant ____ arguing about when to attack.
questions.explanation: 两个冠词说明是两个人,主语为复数,用 were。

questions.stem: War and peace ____ the great theme running through this unit.
questions.explanation: war and peace 在此指同一个主题概念,用单数 is。

questions.stem: The captain and the sergeant ____ both wounded on the beach.
questions.explanation: both 和两个冠词都说明是两个人,用复数 were。

questions.stem: Their courage and their devotion ____ still remembered today.
questions.explanation: 重复的 their 表明是两种品质,主语为复数,用 are。

questions.stem: Fish and chips ____ the simple meal the soldiers missed most.
questions.explanation: fish and chips 是一道菜的固定搭配,指同一事物,用单数 was。

questions.stem: The poet and soldier Laurence Binyon ____ written these famous lines.
questions.explanation: the poet and soldier 同指 Binyon 一人,用单数 has written。

questions.stem: The sea and the sky ____ both grey on the morning of the attack.
questions.explanation: the sea and the sky 是两样事物,加 both,用复数 were。

questions.stem: Law and order ____ slowly returning to the liberated towns.
questions.explanation: law and order 是表示同一概念的固定搭配,用单数 was。

questions.stem: Paris and the towns around it ____ freed by the end of August.
questions.explanation: Paris 与周边城镇是多处地点,主语为复数,用 were。

questions.stem: The needle and thread ____ all the nurse had to close the wound.
questions.explanation: needle and thread 作针线这一整体工具,用单数 was。

questions.stem: Eisenhower and his officers ____ confident of a full victory.
questions.explanation: Eisenhower 与众军官是多个人,主语为复数,用 were。

questions.stem: The aim and purpose of Operation Overlord ____ to free Europe.
questions.explanation: aim and purpose 指同一个目的,用单数 was。

questions.stem: Both the army and the navy ____ needed for the landings to succeed.
questions.explanation: both…and… 连接两支部队,主语为复数,用 were。

questions.stem: The moon and the tide ____ studied for weeks before the date was chosen.
questions.explanation: the moon and the tide 是两样事物,主语为复数,用 were。

questions.stem: The horror and the violence of that day ____ never forgotten by the survivors.
questions.explanation: 重复冠词的 horror and violence 是两件事,主语为复数,用 were。

questions.stem: His wife and his children ____ waiting at home for news of him.
questions.explanation: wife 与 children 是不同的人,主语为复数,用 were。

questions.stem: The cruelty and the waste of war ____ shown clearly in the film.
questions.explanation: 重复冠词说明 cruelty 与 waste 是两件事,主语为复数,用 are。

questions.stem: Each of the soldiers ____ given a parachute before the night jump.
questions.explanation: each of + 复数名词,谓语仍用单数,过去被动用 was given。

questions.stem: Every man and woman in the unit ____ a part to play in the plan.
questions.explanation: every…and every/every…and… 结构作单数,过去用 had。

questions.stem: A number of boats ____ hit by enemy fire that morning.
questions.explanation: a number of + 复数名词,谓语用复数 were。

questions.stem: The number of casualties ____ rising hour by hour.
questions.explanation: the number of 作主语指“数目”,用单数 was。

questions.stem: Neither of the two plans ____ perfect, but one had to be chosen.
questions.explanation: neither of + 复数名词,谓语用单数 was。

questions.stem: Either of these narrow routes ____ likely to be defended by the enemy.
questions.explanation: either of + 复数名词,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Each soldier on the boat ____ his own heavy pack to carry.
questions.explanation: each + 单数名词作主语,谓语用单数,过去用 had。

questions.stem: A number of survivors ____ still meeting every year to remember that day.
questions.explanation: a number of + 复数名词,谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: The number of veterans who attend ____ smaller each year.
questions.explanation: the number of 指“数目”,作单数,用 is。

questions.stem: Every order from the commander ____ to be obeyed at once.
questions.explanation: every + 单数名词作主语,谓语用单数,过去用 had to。

questions.stem: Neither the captain nor his men ____ willing to give up the beach.
questions.explanation: neither…nor… 遵循就近原则,靠近 men(复数),用 were。

questions.stem: Neither the men nor their captain ____ willing to retreat.
questions.explanation: neither…nor… 就近原则,靠近 captain(单数),用 was。

questions.stem: Either the general or his officers ____ going to make the final call.
questions.explanation: either…or… 就近原则,靠近 officers(复数),用 are。

questions.stem: Either the officers or the general ____ going to make the final call.
questions.explanation: either…or… 就近原则,靠近 general(单数),用 is。

questions.stem: Each of the landing boats ____ carrying about thirty men.
questions.explanation: each of + 复数名词,谓语用单数,过去进行用 was carrying。

questions.stem: A large number of weapons ____ collected and locked away after the war.
questions.explanation: a large number of + 复数名词,谓语用复数 were。

questions.stem: The number of weapons handed in ____ greater than anyone had expected.
questions.explanation: the number of 指“数目”,作单数,用 was。

questions.stem: Every soldier and every nurse ____ remembered at the yearly ceremony.
questions.explanation: every…and every… 结构作单数,被动用 is remembered。

questions.stem: Neither of the brothers ____ able to forget the bombing of their city.
questions.explanation: neither of + 复数名词,谓语用单数 was。

questions.stem: Many a young man ____ marched to the front and never returned.
questions.explanation: many a + 单数名词作主语,谓语用单数 has marched。
